accepted.name: project_members_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  unics_id,
  project,
  pic_number,
  rcn,
  member_name,
  activity_type,
  country,
  street,
  city,
  postal_code,
  ec_contribution,
  institution_id,
  member_role,
  geocode_regions_3,
  member_short_name,
  department_name,
  vat_number,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  region_code,
  region_name
FROM
  project_members
accepted.description: Canonical projection of project_members preserving identifiers and key participant attributes (institution linkage, ec_contribution, geocode and region). Useful for participant-level analyses and joins to institutions or projects. | Use for: List or count of participants per project; Aggregate EC contributions by institution or country; Mapping participants to regions or geocodes
